description: CMCC and Kunming Institute of Botany partners publish global potential-evapotranspiration and aridity-index grids at thirty arc-seconds. ScienceDB supplies monthly and annual GeoTIFF summaries for two historical baselines and future periods 2021–2040 and 2041–2060, drawing on 22 CMIP6 models and four SSP scenarios. Separate ensemble summaries distinguish all available models, a high-risk subset and a majority-consensus subset. CC BY 4.0 permits free reuse. The grids can inform agricultural-water and drought scenarios in infrastructure simulations. Temperature-based Hargreaves estimates and downscaled climate inputs carry uncertainty; PET does not equal actual irrigation withdrawal. Hargreaves uses monthly means and temperature ranges. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
